result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content bug showing a '-0%' discount badge, and a minor issue with the partially cut-off restaurant card.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card displays a discount badge reading '-0%', which is a nonsensical/placeholder value that suggests a data or calculation bug instead of a real discount or promotion.
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount calculation or default value so badges only render when there is an actual non-zero discount (e.g., '-15%'), or hide the badge entirely when no discount applies.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the screen edge with a truncated name, which is expected in a carousel but the truncation looks abrupt without any visual affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle peek/edge indicator or partial card spacing so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable.
